steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Absolutely not! You've already spent so much money and time on me. If I delay you for another day, I'll never be able to repay your kindness in this lifetime!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You see, if it weren't for my leg injury, we would have gone straight to meet up with Benefactor Lava. Now, you have a perfect opportunity to go and have a good look around. As they say, a blessing in disguise—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I know you mean well. But even if you don't need looking after, we still need our funds to last until we reach the office. There's no extra money for sightseeing.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Oh, how foolish of me! You fronted my medical expenses with the funds, which is why you're short on cash.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Don't worry, Benefactor. Why squeeze into crowded tourist spots to enjoy nature? Besides the Three Mountains and Seventeen Peaks, Shangshu has plenty of other sights worth seeing. I guarantee you'll have a great time without it costing you a thing.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Let me recommend a few sightseeing routes for you right now.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hmm... The landscape photo in that newspaper you're holding looks beautiful.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Oh, this is a newspaper about local ghost stories. You can't go to the places in here, I'm afraid there might be... unclean things...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Unclean things? I'll just be careful. Help me find the address for that place.
Mount Yanji—shrouded in light snow and mist, like an otherworldly wonderland. This scenery can only be appreciated during that one month in early spring each year.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Whew—so refreshing. I really chose a great place.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hmm? 'Sightseeing Route 1, Normal, twenty-minute trip; Route 2, Climbing, two-hour trip.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: 'Note: Route 2 has many forks and rugged paths. Be sure to walk along the main road to avoid danger.'

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The climbing route... The view from up there must be even better. Where do I go up?
Following the arrow on the signpost, she saw a hidden path winding deep into the mountains.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Is this the main road? It seems like this is the only option. I'll scout ahead first.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Brr, it feels so cold now that I'm deep in the mountains.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I can't see the signposts clearly. How did the fog get so thick all of a sudden? It's risky to keep going up...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Huh? Were there this many paths when I came? The footprints are so messy, I can't tell which path I just walked up...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The communicator—no signal, and I can't rely on navigation either. Oh dear.
The chilly wind brought the faint sound of a woman's soft laughter.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ah, is someone there? Maybe I can ask for directions.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ouch, that's hard.
What tripped Kroos was a small mound of dirt with a wooden plaque standing on it, engraved with two lines of characters.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: 'Grave of Gu the Ninth'.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: 'Those who dig up graves shall have their hands and feet rot, and suffer bad luck for a lifetime'?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh dear, there is a deceased person buried down here. But without this extra line, nobody would have known there was treasure underneath, right?

Curious, Kroos brushed aside a thin layer of soil, and sure enough, a heavy silver ingot was hidden inside. The silver ingot gleamed with an enticing metallic luster, lying there on the ground completely unattended.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It looks like it's made of precious metal. Silver?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hmm... What should I do now?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Looking around)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Okay, let's do that.
Give it to me...
Kroos took a giant step back, distancing herself from the voice that had suddenly appeared in front of her, her crossbow ready to fire.

Composing herself, she finally saw clearly that the person who had quietly appeared before her was a woman in plain clothes with a pale, ashen face. The woman stood with her hands at her sides, staring straight at her.

steps.name: Ashen-faced Woman
steps.text: You took it. Give it back to me... Give it back...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Eh? What did I take?

steps.name: Ashen-faced Woman
steps.text: Hehehe... Playing dumb... Your hands are covered in dirt. You dug up my... my treasure!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You showed up just in time. Why don't you go check if your treasure is still there?

The ashen-faced woman stared at her suspiciously and slowly squatted down, only to find that the originally thin layer of soil had turned into a thick mixture of fallen leaves and dirt, packed very tightly.
Once the woman cleared away the dirt, the silver ingot was revealed underneath.

steps.name: Ashen-faced Woman
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: By the way, I also wiped off the writing on this wooden plaque for you. Be more careful next time.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: While it's still light out, I'll go look for the way down the mountain. Goodbye.

steps.name: Ashen-faced Woman
steps.text: You... don't go!

steps.name: Ashen-faced Woman
steps.text: I misjudged you just now. I must apologize properly.

steps.name: Ashen-faced Woman
steps.text: Come with me. My cottage is nearby. Come over to my place for a cup of hot tea. Once the fog clears, I'll show you the way down the mountain.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: There's actually a house nearby? Okay, sorry for the intrusion then.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (This looks like a path I've already walked. I didn't see a house here just now, did I?)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Cough, cough! So much dust... It smells like dirt...)

steps.name: Ashen-faced Woman
steps.text: Please, sit wherever you like.

steps.name: Ashen-faced Woman
steps.text: My name is Yin, and I'm a Shangshu local. What about you? I've met so many people, yet I can't place your accent.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm not from Yan. It's just that I've lived in quite a few countries, and my current job brings me into contact with people from all over, so my accent naturally got a bit mixed.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Not from Yan? I see! Haha, well, no wonder!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No wonder?

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Do you recognize what this is in my hand?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's silver, right? A precious metal. It can be found outside of Yan as well.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Wrong! This is no normal metal! It's money!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ah... currency. I've been here for so many days, and I haven't seen anyone use this. But if it's highly valuable, it makes sense that it's rarely seen.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Of course! A silver ingot this large weighs a full fifty taels. This single piece is more than what many people can earn in a lifetime.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: With this, buying an entire estate would be no problem, let alone rouge and powder, or fine clothes and gourmet food.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: You didn't covet my wealth, which is good. Otherwise, how could a weak and defenseless woman like me ever keep it...
Yin stuffs the silver ingot into her clothes right in front of Kroos. Judging by the bulges in her clothing, there is more than one ingot hidden beneath the fabric.
Yin seems to feel uncomfortable from the hard lumps, grumbling as she rubs them, and the sound of metal clinking together comes from her clothes.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: When will the fog clear...

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Soon. I'm going to rest for a bit. Please, suit yourself.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: But I'm sorry. It's not that I don't trust you, but greedy people don't write 'greedy' on their faces. Carrying such treasures with me, I must take some precautions.

After saying this, Yin draws a short sword and goes to sleep fully clothed. At first, she tightly guards the spot where the silver ingots are hidden with her hand, but before long, her breathing becomes steady, and her hand gradually lets go of the short sword.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Heh... Ah...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Silently and slowly approaching Yin)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Taking the short sword from her hand)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Slowly reaching into Yin's clothes to retrieve something)
Yin snapped her eyes open and reached out to grab Kroos's wrist, but Kroos nimbly dodged. Her eyes widened as she saw Kroos holding the short sword in one hand, and in the other...
...the scabbard taken from her clothes, preparing to sheathe the blade. She patted the silver ingots inside her clothes; not a single one was missing.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I didn't want to wake you.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's far too dangerous for someone without special training to sleep with an unsheathed weapon in hand.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: At least while I'm here, you don't have to worry about your belongings being stolen. Put the sword away.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: You! What on earth...!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: It's nothing! I'm going back to sleep!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Such quiet snow...
In the dense forest, the raided escort cart lies on its side, and the injured escort guards are held at knifepoint against a tree.

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: Eh? How did I end up here? Where's the cabin?

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: Escort, go back and tell your Chief Escort Lin that since he doesn't care about his reputation as a hero and colludes with that corrupt official Liu Yu, our Browncoat Gang will earn some good karma on his behalf.

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: This chest is filled with wealth wrung from the people. What was taken from them shall be returned to them, to aid those suffering from the drought that has lasted since March.

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: If Chief Escort Lin is blinded by greed and insists on doing injustice to the people of the world, he is welcome to settle scores with us. Got that? Now scram!

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: Hah! Bunch of cowards. Spill a little blood and they scatter like rats. Hey, I sent you to check the cargo—how'd it go? Why are you standing there? Yeah, you!

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: Is there anyone else here?! Is there two thousand taels of silver in the chest?

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: Uh... I'll go take a look.

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: Two thousand taels... how much is that? This chest is completely intact, so nothing should be missing, right?

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: Should? You haven't even opened the chest, and you dare say nothing is missing? Move!
The bandit smashed open the wooden chest, revealing dazzling silver ingots neatly arranged inside. He took out two, tossed one to 'Kroos', and then closed the chest.

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: No respect for the rules.

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: I don't understand. Please, tell me about these rules. If we take some of the silver ingots that weren't missing in the first place, won't they be missing now?

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: Are you stupid? If you hand over an intact chest, what are the headmen supposed to do with it?

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: Hah?

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: The chest was already broken. A few silver ingots went missing in the fight. As for how many—once we turn it in, Master Li can decide for himself.

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: Once he hands it up, Master Lu will take his turn. Then it goes to the Chief, and those under the Chief will all have to make their calls too.

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: In the end, if there are one or two silver ingots left to distribute to those refugees, they should thank their lucky stars!

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: It wouldn't have been your turn anyway, but since you came out to work with me, you'll naturally get your share. Got it?!

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: So I was the one who didn't know the rules.

steps.name: Bandit
steps.text: You...! You want to keep it all for yourself? Where are you going?!
'Kroos' walked toward the disaster-stricken area with the chest, and the dense forest returned to silence. Only the pocketed silver ingot fell from the bandit's body.

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: Huh? How did I end up back here again?

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: The place where the bandits had their infighting should be around here. Looking at how dense the footprints are, there are plenty of people who had the same idea as us, but...

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: These days, I keep hearing about people finding silver ingots, but no one has actually seen them. It seems the real deal is still up on this mountain.

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: Silver ingots?

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: A full two thousand taels.

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: (Could they be talking about the infighting the Browncoats had here? Didn't I already distribute that money to the refugees?)

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: (No, I wanted to take the money down the mountain, and then, and then...?)

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: They talked like blood brothers, but all that didn't save 'em from dying over a few trinkets. If we find anything, no skimming off the top—we split it fair and square.

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: It's a vast expanse of white snow here. Even if the rumors are true, the silver ingots would have been buried deep under it long ago. Where do you plan to look?
The mountain farmer said nothing, swinging his hoe and turning over almost all the soil on the mountain path. He was dripping with sweat, yet found absolutely nothing.

As if intentionally meant to be found, at this very moment, a glint of metallic color was revealed in the snow where 'Kroos' had stepped. She bent down to dig it out, and it was indeed a heavy silver ingot.

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: Gu the Ninth? What's wrong, did you find something? ...Such a huge one!

steps.name: Kroos?
steps.text: (Gu the Ninth? Such a familiar name. Where did I see it today... Ah, on the wooden plaque of that dirt grave.)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: 'Grave of Gu the Ninth'.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: 'Those who dig up graves shall have their hands and feet rot, and suffer bad luck for a lifetime'?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: This... This is great. My daughter... she has a chance now... right? You'll... share the money with me, right?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No need to hold your hoe so tightly. Here.

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: You're really just giving it to me? What about you? Such a large sum of money, don't you need it yourself...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Me...

steps.name: Fang
steps.text: Kroos, back to duty with me!

steps.name: Instructor Grace
steps.text: That's why we're your teachers. That's what we're here for.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Alright, don't look so down. Smile! You still have to go over to Fang!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Remember to bring me back some local specialties from Columbia next time!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: There's a saying in Yan, 'take things as they come.' It probably refers to lazy people like me.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: If you ask what I'd do with a large sum of money... Eat some delicious food? Install an upgrade module on my crossbow? I already do those things normally.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It seems there's nothing extra I need to buy... You can have it.

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: Utter nonsense!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hah?
Utter...

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Utter nonsense!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Heh... Ah, I haven't slept this soundly in a long time.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Are... Are you actually asleep!? Are your eyes open or closed? Can't you see what this silver ingot can do for you?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I see what I need to see. What is it that you want me to see?
Yin suddenly falls silent, not daring to say another word.
Those half-open eyes saw not the easily stolen money on her person, but rather her deeply hidden, unspeakable secrets.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: When you asked me to stay, I was willing to stay because you looked like you wouldn't let me off easily.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: I... didn't...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You followed me on purpose, using the fog to create those messy footprints and hiding your silver ingot in a place where it could easily be found.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: One, two, three, four, five...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I saw at least ten graves along the way.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Those infights, those brawls... they really happened, didn't they?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: How many years have you been here? I'm afraid you've committed quite a few crimes.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What use is other people's greed to you, anyway?

Yin's expression changed instantly as she lunged at Kroos, only to find nothing but empty air. The Cautus, who had been calmly analyzing the situation just a moment ago, had suddenly vanished into the fog.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Where did she go?

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Have you come to make me pay for my sins?!

steps.name: Voice from the East
steps.text: What kind of sins?

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Where? To the right?!

steps.name: Voice from the West
steps.text: Tell me about them.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: To the left?!
A crossbow bolt thuds into the snow at Yin's feet. She shrieks and takes a step back.

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: Today was my mistake. I didn't know who I was messing with...

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: But I've never killed anyone! The people here brought this upon themselves! By their own... greed!

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: You didn't fall for my tricks because you are truly virtuous and without flaws. There is no way I could ever harm you. I beg of you, have mercy and let me go!

steps.name: Voice from Above
steps.text: Hmm... Let you go, and then what?

steps.name: Yin
steps.text: I will definitely leave this place and turn over a new leaf—
Before she can finish, a crossbow bolt pierces through the thick fog, striking Yin with precision. Her cries come to an abrupt halt.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: By the time I went to check, the fog had suddenly cleared, and the woman I shot was nowhere to be found.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Oh my, that's terrible! I told you that place was haunted.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I see a dark shadow over your brow. I happen to have a peachwood ward right here. It's yours for half price—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Mr. Nothing.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Just kidding. I'm sure you'll be just fine.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But did that woman really tell you that the silver ingot was Yan currency?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Yan did indeed use precious metals as currency for a time, but that was a very long time ago.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: No matter what you encountered, that thing seems to feed on human greed, which is why it deliberately tempted you.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You did not fall for her tricks, which truly shows a noble soul with integrity untainted. Even facing such desperation for money, you never even considered taking a coin.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ah, right, I forgot that we are short on money.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No need to paint me as so noble. Of course I have greed. It is just that...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (It's just that my greed isn't something money can satisfy...)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Anyway, since you can stand up now, let's go and...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Huh? Strange, where is it?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: ...What is it?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: The silver ingot. After I shot that woman, only a silver ingot was left on the ground. I suspected something was off, so I took it with me. Shouldn't strange occurrences like this be handled by the Tianshis in Yan?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Then losing it is bad news indeed.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Mountain Farmer
steps.text: These days, I keep hearing about people finding silver ingots, but no one has actually seen them. It seems the real deal is still up on this mountain.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm not entirely sure, but I don't think it was lost.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: All for a moment of greed, they hurt those beside them and those who had nothing to do with it. What did they really gain in the end?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Anyway, let's find a Tianshi and explain the situation.
